question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

7 28 84 336 1008 ?
solution:
Logic : Alternately (4) and (3) are multiplied by each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f813e86d67b3a9d2b1574c46a43477cfe1bfd745f80f0cad2e1499980cc8728.png] 

Hence, "4032" is the correct answer.
